Amending the bootstrap commit hooks-off to include the product change, then running SDD with an empty implement through close, is graded compliant and fullSddCompleted: the grader anchors on manifestIntroduction (the rewritten commit) and never checks that the recorded bootstrap revision is still an ancestor of HEAD. Audit startRevision..HEAD and require ancestry, with a test.
